title: Vantage Folder
description: A Folder for organizing Cost Reports within a Workspace, supporting nested folder hierarchies.

token.description: The unique token identifier for the Folder.

parent_folder_token.description: The token of the parent Folder, if nested.

workspace_token.description: The token of the Workspace this Folder belongs to.

created_at.description: The date and time the Folder was created.
